test_pack_unpack_any: test packing a protobuf message into an Any type and unpacking it back to the original message
test_unpack_as_any: test unpacking an Any message as a specific protobuf message type using unpack_as
test_type_name_any: test extracting the type name from a packed Any protobuf message
test_is_type_any: test checking if an Any message matches a given protobuf descriptor using is_type
test_any_type_mismatch: test that unpacking an Any message to an incorrect type raises a TypeError
